top_50.generated_answer: Fold birdwatching into your daily dog walks. Take compact binoculars and your notebook on quick trips to a nearby park or dog park, and spend 15–30 minutes logging sightings while Buddy/Toby get their exercise. This uses the time you already have, fits your city routine, and leverages the gear you planned to bring.
